<content>
1: // Simple side‑scrolling runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Set canvas to full width/height of its container or a fixed size.
13:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
14:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
15:   // initialize background stars
16:   initStars();
17: 
18:   // Player (glowing dot)
19:   const player = {
20:     x: 50,
21:     y: height - 20,
22:     radius: 10,
23:     vy: 0,
24:     jumpStrength: -12,
25:     color: '#0ff',
26:     onGround: true,
27:   };
28: 
29:   const gravity = 0.6;
30:   // audio context for sound effects
31:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
32:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
33:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
34:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
35:     osc.type = 'sine';
36:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
37:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
38:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
39:     osc.start();
40:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
41:   }
42:   const speed = 4; // world scroll speed
43:   // stars for background
44:   const starCount = 80;
45:   let stars = [];
46:   function initStars() {
47:     stars = [];
48:     for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
49:       stars.push({
50:         x: Math.random() * width,
51:         y: Math.random() * height,
52:         speed: speed * 0.5 + Math.random(),
53:       });
54:     }
55:   }
56:   let obstacles = [];
57:   let frames = 0;
58:   let score = 0;
59:   let running = true;
60: 
61:   function spawnObstacle() {
62:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
63:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 40;
64:     obstacles.push({
65:       x: width,
66:       y: height - h,
67:       w,
68:       h,
69:       color: '#f0f',
70:     });
71:   }
72: 
73:   function update() {
74:     if (!running) return;
75:     frames++;
76:     // increase score each frame (~60 per second)
77:     if (frames % 60 === 0) score++;
78: 
79:     // player physics
80:     player.vy += gravity;
81:     player.y += player.vy;
82:     if (player.y >= height - player.radius) {
83:       player.y = height - player.radius;
84:       player.vy = 0;
85:       player.onGround = true;
86:     }
87: 
88:     // move obstacles left
89:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= speed);
90:     // move stars for parallax effect
91:     stars.forEach(s => {
92:       s.x -= s.speed;
93:       if (s.x < 0) {
94:         s.x = width;
95:         s.y = Math.random() * height;
96:       }
97:     });
98:     // remove off‑screen obstacles
99:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
100: 
101:     // spawn new obstacles periodically
102:     if (frames % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
103: 
104:     // collision detection (dot vs rectangle)
105:     for (const o of obstacles) {
106:       const withinX = player.x + player.radius > o.x && player.x - player.radius < o.x + o.w;
107:       const withinY = player.y + player.radius > o.y && player.y - player.radius < o.y + o.h;
108:       if (withinX && withinY) {
109:         running = false;
110:         // play collision sound
111:         playTone(100, 0.3);
112:         break;
113:       }
114:     }
115:   }
116: 
117:   function draw() {
118:     // clear
119:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
120:     // background with subtle gradient
121:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
122:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2a');
123:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000011');
124:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
125:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
126: 
127:     // stars (parallax)
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
129:     stars.forEach(s => {
130:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 2, 2);
131:     });
132: 
133:     // player with neon glow
134:     ctx.save();
135:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
136:     ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
137:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, player.radius * 0.2, player.x, player.y, player.radius);
138:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
139:     grad.addColorStop(1, player.color);
140:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
141:     ctx.beginPath();
142:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
143:     ctx.fill();
144:     ctx.restore();
145:     // obstacles with neon glow
146:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
147:       ctx.save();
148:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
149:       ctx.shadowColor = o.color;
150:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
151:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
152:       ctx.restore();
153:     });
154:     // score
155:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
156:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
157:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
158:     // game over overlay
159:     if (!running) {
160:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
161:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
162:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f88';
163:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
164:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
165:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 10);
166:       ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
167:       ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, width / 2, height / 2 + 30);
168:     }
169:   }
170: 
171:   function loop() {
172:     update();
173:     draw();
174:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175:   }
176: 
177:   // input handling
178:   function jump() {
179:     if (player.onGround) {
180:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
181:       player.onGround = false;
182:       // play jump sound
183:       playTone(300, 0.1);
184:     }
185:   }
186:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.key === ' ') jump(); });
187:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', jump);
188: 
189:   // start
190:   loop();
191: })();

(End of file - total 191 lines)
</content>
